notes.title: Update Ver1.06（2020/10/8 ）
notes.notes:
The following updates have been applied.
---------------------------------------------------------------
 - Added "The story so far" when starting the game.
 Note: Even if a game has already been started, the "The story so far" can be viewed by selecting "Gallery" - "Movies" from Lucy's House.
 Corrected typographical errors and messages.
 Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Update Ver1.04（2020/8/24 ）

Added Keyboard Setting functions

- Keyboard Settings can be accessed during gameplay.

notes.title: Update Ver1.01（2020/8/06 ）
notes.notes:
The following updates have been applied.
---------------------------------------------------------------
Added the Photo Mode feature. Place and arrange characters using the poses of your choice and get snapping!
- Enjoy taking pictures of characters by using different features as you wander around
- Character placements and poses can be arranged freely
- Several frames, including a Comic Book Frame,  for you to choose from
Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Fairy Tail dishes out 24 minutes of gameplay before release next month
notes.notes:
On the list of anime that were just a bit too action-y for teenage me is Fairy Tail, though of course that’s part of what makes it a good candidate for an RPG spinoff. It’s not the first time the series has been treated to a game adaption, but this will be its first proper PC release. Koei Tecmo are gearing up for July’s release with a new gameplay video showing 24 minutes of cutscenes and combat from early in the game.
